raw_posts.name: DeepCell
raw_posts.tagline: Your deadline survival kit for office work
raw_posts.description: Deepcell can help you with deadline tasks that require narrations, calculation and presentation at the same time, such as modeling, sales review, budget forecast and monthly report. DeepCell (both web app and agent plug-in) can create ready-to-use docs, spreadsheets, and slides—with sources and cheat sheets to help you explain. Furthermore, every edit can update related parts. The product is built on a newly designed document format (.deepcell), which is especially designed for system two tasks.

raw_posts.name: Claude Duet
raw_posts.tagline: Proactive agent that understands what needs your attention
raw_posts.description: Claude Duet is a helpful, proactive agent you hand off work to through messages. Tell it what you need and it works on its own computer in the cloud, using apps you connect. It messages you when it is done or needs a decision from you. While it’s always on, it uses good judgment when it reaches out and knows what can wait.

raw_posts.name: Doneas
raw_posts.tagline: A daily accountability call with other entrepreneurs.
raw_posts.description: Doneas helps solo builders stay focused, accountable, and productive. Plan your week every Monday, join a 15-minute daily accountability call with five other builders, and track everything you ship on your public progress page. Plan less. Focus better. Ship more.

raw_posts.name: heal.dev
raw_posts.tagline: Find bugs and vulnerabilities code review misses
raw_posts.description: Code review catches what’s wrong in a diff. Heal catches what breaks when the app runs. Heal learns how to run your application, builds a production-like sandbox with external services stubbed, then hunts for bugs, performance regressions, and runtime vulnerabilities users would hit. It reproduces every defect before reporting it, so you get real bugs to fix, not a backlog of AI-generated suspicions.

raw_posts.name: Mistral Voxtral 3
raw_posts.tagline: Mistral’s speech models for transcription, TTS and agents
raw_posts.description: Voxtral 3 is Mistral’s new family of speech-to-text and text-to-speech models, plus a voice agent SDK built on LiveKit. Transcription covers 50+ languages with diarization and context biasing, and realtime transcription runs under 500ms. TTS adapts emotion and pacing, with voice cloning from 30+ minutes of audio. Batch transcription starts at $0.0035 per minute, and the models are available through Mistral’s API.

raw_posts.name: Fastlane 2.0
raw_posts.tagline: Create, launch and scale winning ads with AI
raw_posts.description: Meet Fastlane 2.0 - your next winning ad, on autopilot. What started as a simple AI organic content creation tool now runs your paid marketing end to end. Enter your website and Fastlane learns your brand, researches competitors and finds what's working. It creates high-quality AI video and image ads, runs Meta campaigns and publishes content across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. Then it studies results, doubles down on winners and uses those learnings to build smarter campaigns every time.

raw_posts.name: Loom Record for agents
raw_posts.tagline: Hit record and hand off to AI, now in the new Loom app
raw_posts.description: Record your screen, a meeting, yourself and now…record for agents. No more typing out prompts to explain what's on your screen to agents. Capture video, audio, and on-screen actions, turning everyday walkthroughs into agent-ready prompts any AI tool can act on. Built natively into the reimagined, faster Loom for Mac app with precision area recording, new cam shapes, filters, backgrounds, and 4K capture by default. Give your AI agents the full picture. Also available in the Chrome extension.

raw_posts.name: CutBay
raw_posts.tagline: AI Video Agent: Turn Anything into Videos via Chat
raw_posts.description: CutBay is an AI video agent that turns anything into videos via chat. Instead of manually editing timelines, users simply describe what they want, and CutBay handles planning, scripting, visuals, voiceovers, subtitles, and editing. It creates videos from prompts, URLs, docs, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and media assets, then refines them through natural conversation. Professional video creation, as easy as having a conversation.

raw_posts.name: Dadan
raw_posts.tagline: One AI video workspace for recordings, meetings and guides
raw_posts.description: Most teams juggle one tool for async video, another for meeting notes, and a third for how-to docs. Dadan brings all three together, then goes further: make any video interactive with polls, CTAs, and lead forms that turn viewers into signups. Built for sales, marketing, and customer success teams creating demos, onboarding, and training content. Product Hunt offer: 3 months free on PRO with code PRODUCTHUNT
